_comment: CS-3979 / CS-3992: log metric filters and alarms for one bank's allowance jobs. Applied per bank by scripts/jobs-alarms.sh (dry run by default). Markers come from src/jobs/alerts.ts. Alarm actions go to an SNS topic whose owner is named at activation (runbook J6); nothing here names a person.

alarms.name: missed-run
alarms.meaning: A cycle was decided after a later week had ended: a run was missed. Check the job ran at the cut-off.

alarms.name: unexpected-failed
alarms.meaning: BOB refused a PAY with something other than AUTHORITY_REVOKED (wrong-bank credential, insufficient funds, ...). Not retried.

alarms.name: operator-hold
alarms.meaning: A cycle is held after repeated mismatched answers; the Guardian cannot change the allowance until it is rechecked (runbook J9).

alarms.name: cycle-error
alarms.meaning: A cycle threw (database or code error); it is retried next tick.

alarms.name: lease-lost
alarms.meaning: Leaders keep losing the bank's lease mid-tick: runners are flapping or the database is slow.

alarms.name: job-failed
alarms.meaning: A registered job threw out of its run.

alarms.name: no-heartbeat
alarms.meaning: No leader of this bank completed a tick for 15 minutes while jobs should be running: allowances are not being paid promptly (the no-backfill condition depends on this).
